summary.title: ShopSphere Microservices STRIDE Model
summary.description: STRIDE-per-element threat model of an e-commerce microservice system.

data.name: Customer
data.description: Shopper using web or mobile app

threats.title: Impersonation of Customer
threats.description: An attacker uses stolen, guessed or phished credentials or session tokens to act as Customer.
threats.mitigation: Enforce MFA, strong password policy, short-lived tokens, login anomaly detection.

threats.title: Customer denies performing an action
threats.description: Customer claims an order, payment or change was never made and the system cannot prove otherwise.
threats.mitigation: Tamper-evident audit logs with user ID, time and source IP.

threats.title: Payment Provider denies performing an action

threats.title: Spoofed caller or fake instance of API Gateway
threats.description: A rogue service or attacker impersonates a trusted caller of API Gateway, or pretends to be API Gateway.
threats.mitigation: Mutual TLS between services, signed JWTs, service mesh identity.

threats.title: Malicious input or code change in API Gateway
threats.description: Injection or parameter tampering, or a modified image/config, changes how API Gateway behaves.
threats.mitigation: Input and schema validation, signed container images, immutable deployments.

threats.title: Missing audit trail in API Gateway
threats.description: Actions handled by API Gateway are not logged, so incidents cannot be investigated or users held accountable.
threats.mitigation: Central, append-only structured logging with correlation IDs.

threats.title: Data leakage from API Gateway
threats.description: Verbose errors, debug endpoints or logs of API Gateway reveal secrets or personal data.
threats.mitigation: Generic error messages, log scrubbing, secrets manager.

threats.title: Resource exhaustion of API Gateway
threats.description: Request flooding or heavy calls exhaust CPU, memory or threads of API Gateway.
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting, timeouts, circuit breakers, autoscaling.

threats.title: Broken access control in API Gateway
threats.description: A low-privileged caller performs admin or cross-user operations in API Gateway.
threats.mitigation: RBAC/ABAC check on every request, least-privilege service accounts.

threats.title: Unauthorised modification of data in Users DB
threats.description: SQL injection or a stolen DB account lets an attacker change or delete records in Users DB.
threats.mitigation: Least-privilege DB accounts, parameterised queries, integrity checks.

threats.title: Untraceable changes in Users DB
threats.description: Changes to Users DB are not logged, so who changed what is unknown.
threats.mitigation: Database audit logging and change history.

threats.title: Data theft from Users DB
threats.description: Stolen backups, direct access or injection expose data stored in Users DB.
threats.mitigation: Encryption at rest, field-level encryption for PII, network isolation.

threats.title: Users DB unavailable or destroyed
threats.description: Ransomware, disk exhaustion or an outage makes Users DB unusable.
threats.mitigation: Backups, replication, resource quotas.

threats.title: Data modified in transit on F1 Browse and checkout
threats.description: A man-in-the-middle changes messages travelling over F1 Browse and checkout.
threats.mitigation: TLS 1.2+ or mutual TLS, message signing.

threats.title: Eavesdropping on F1 Browse and checkout
threats.description: Network sniffing exposes tokens, personal or payment data sent over F1 Browse and checkout.
threats.mitigation: TLS 1.2+ or mutual TLS for every hop, including internal ones.

threats.title: Flooding or blocking of F1 Browse and checkout
threats.description: Excess traffic or dropped connections interrupt F1 Browse and checkout.
threats.mitigation: Rate limiting, quotas, retry with back-off.
